content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Org 'GreenSprout' qps spike detected. 99th p50 latency rising, token errors increasing. Auto-throttle triggered.

lena: I'm on it. Paging oncall.

sara: oncall here, joining. What's the org id?

mike: GreenSprout org_id=org_0xGS, spike to 4.8k qps, current org limit is 600 qps. Error 429s at edge.

lena: Oof. Is this customer on Dedicated or Hosted?

cs-alex: Hosted. They just rolled a new batch job at 18:12 UTC (they mentioned in support).

sara: Plan: temporary emergency rate increase to 3k qps for 10m, plus enable per-consumer token concurrency cap to preserve fairness. Then monitor.

mike: I'll run the CLI to bump and add a fast rollback. Command:
```
redwoodctl org update-rate --org org_0xGS --qps 3000 --duration 10m --reason "Emergency spike hotpatch"
```

ops-runbook: Remember to annotate the incident in runbook and trigger CS notify if we do >5m bypass.

lena: Executing now.

mike: ✅ Command executed. System returned job_id=job_7892. Throttle metrics now show ingress dropping to ~2.9k qps.

sara: Seeing error rates fall from 8% -> 0.9%. Latency back to baseline. Keep 10m window, then automatic rollback.

cs-alex: I'll DM the customer to ask them to pause the batch job and will loop back in 5m.

lena: Post-mitigation actions: add check in org onboarding for batch scheduling guidance, and add a rule to prod-rl policy to restrict sudden bursts >2x baseline.

sara: Filing follow-up ticket: INCIDENT-4823 (owner: mike). I'll add logs and graphs.

incident-bot: Incident note: emergency-rate-adjust applied for org_0xGS. Mitigation active. Reminder to update channel when rollback completes. :white_check_mark:
